mapper.select: SELECT e.genre_character_id, e.user_id, e.genre_character_group_id, e.name, e.description, e.created_at, e.updated_at, CONCAT('/uploads/', t.file_path) AS thumbnail_url FROM genre_character e LEFT JOIN thumbnail_image t ON t.user_id = e.user_id AND t.target_type = 'GENRE_CHARACTER' AND t.target_id = e.genre_character_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.genre_character_id
